formula: MEDIAN(business days from Requisition Approved to Candidate Joined) over filled requisitions
cohort_rule: Filled requisitions with an evidenced approval and joining timestamp; open cases excluded

formula: MEDIAN(business days from first Requisition Submitted to Requisition Approved)
cohort_rule: Requisitions with both a submission and a final approval event

formula: COUNT(measured SLA intervals within target) / COUNT(all measured SLA intervals)
cohort_rule: Completed SLA intervals only, each measured against its own priority-specific target

formula: SUM(minutes in intervals with a recorded waiting reason) / SUM(case elapsed business minutes)
cohort_rule: Completed cases. Milestone-to-milestone elapsed time - active time is not inferred

kpi_name: Candidate Conversion Rate (shortlist review to interview)
formula: COUNT(applications with an interview conducted) / COUNT(applications with a shortlist decision)
cohort_rule: Applications whose shortlist review reached a decision; still-pending reviews excluded

formula: COUNT(offers accepted) / COUNT(offers with a final response)
cohort_rule: Offers with a final response. Pending (12) and expired offers are reported separately

formula: COUNT(candidates joined) / COUNT(accepted offers that reached a joining decision)
cohort_rule: Accepted offers with an evidenced joining or non-joining outcome (mature cohort only)

formula: COUNT(withdrawn applications) / COUNT(applications that reached a screening decision)
cohort_rule: Applications past screening, excluding those closed by requisition cancellation

formula: COUNT(cases with >=1 rework loop) / COUNT(completed cases)
cohort_rule: Completed cases. A rework loop is a return to an already-completed activity or stage

formula: COUNT(cases with every mandatory control evidenced) / COUNT(cases)
cohort_rule: All cases. A documented policy exception is treated as conformant, not as a breach

formula: P90(weighted open requisition load) / MEDIAN(weighted open requisition load) across weekly snapshots
cohort_rule: Weekly recruiter snapshots. Balanced load is the goal, not a minimised load

formula: SUM(measured persona hours x rate + agency + assessment cost) / COUNT(hires)
cohort_rule: Hires on filled requisitions. Only 13.0% of events carry a reliable duration, so this is measured effort, not total effort (9.78 hours per hire)
